start: Today, the first screen after sign-in; a gym with members, payments and check-ins

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: Title 'Today' with today’s date under it
One line about the plan: the trial line, or the renew reminder, or the plan-ended line (only one of the three)

Tiles: 'Today's collection' (under it 'This month <amount>'), 'Active members' ('With a running plan'), 'Ending today' ('Last day of their plan'), 'Ending in 1-3 days' ('Renew them now'), 'Ending in 4-7 days' ('Remind them this week'), 'Ending in 8-15 days' ('Coming up'), 'Expired' ('<n> in the last <days> days'), 'Fees due' ('<n> members'), 'Birthdays today' ('Send a wish'), 'Came in today' ('Open the register'), 'Enquiries to call' ('Follow-ups due')
must_not: A voided payment counted in 'Today's collection' or 'This month'
The dues of an archived member dropped from 'Fees due'
Two of the three plan lines at once

steps.action: Tap the tile 'Ending in 1-3 days'
user_sees: The members list filtered to plans ending in 1 to 3 days
must_not: A list whose count differs from the number on the tile

steps.action: Go back and read the three lists under the tiles
user_sees: 'Talk to these members' (at most 6, each '<plan> · ends <day>' or '<plan> · expired <day>', link 'See all')
'Money to collect' (the 6 largest dues, each '<amount> due', link 'See all')
'Losing the habit' (at most 6, link 'See all')
must_not: A member who left long ago in 'Talk to these members'
A member with nothing due in 'Money to collect'

steps.action: Tap a member’s name in a list
user_sees: That member’s page
must_not: Another member’s page

start: Other entry: a Monday; the card 'Last week at your gym' on Today

steps.action: Open Today on a Monday
user_sees: Card 'Last week at your gym'
'Send last week’s money, plans sold and check-ins to yourself or your partner on WhatsApp.'
Button 'Share on WhatsApp'
must_not: The card on any other day of the week
The card for a login that may not see money totals

steps.action: Tap 'Share on WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab with last week’s numbers typed in, and asks who to send it to
must_not: The summary sent to anyone without the owner choosing a chat and pressing send
This week’s or today’s numbers in a 'last week' message

start: Other entry: the card 'Came in today with an ended plan or fees due'

steps.action: Open Today after a member with an ended plan, or with fees due, was checked in today
user_sees: Card 'Came in today with an ended plan or fees due'
'They checked in today. Ask them to renew or pay before they leave.'
At most 5 rows: name and 'Plan ended <date>', 'No plan bought' or 'No running plan today', and '<amount> due' when they owe
With more than 5: '<n> more in the register.'
must_not: A member with a running plan and nothing due on this card
The card left empty on screen when nobody fits (it should not show at all)

steps.action: Tap 'Message' on a row
user_sees: The ready WhatsApp message sheet for that member: the fees message when they owe, the plan-ended message otherwise
must_not: A message sent before the owner presses send
The fees message for a member who owes nothing

start: Negative: a brand-new gym with no member, sale, payment, check-in or enquiry

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: Title 'Today' and the date
The gym code card and the shop card
No number tiles, no lists, no 'Your numbers'
must_not: A wall of tiles that all say 0
The set-up steps list (it lives on 'Set up your gym')

steps.action: Add the first member, then open Today again
user_sees: The tiles and the three lists appear
'Nobody to follow up' with 'No plans are ending soon, and no plan ended in the last <days> days.'
'Everyone has paid' with 'No member has dues.'
'Start checking members in' with 'After a few days of check-ins, this fills in by itself.'
must_not: 'Everybody is training' while the register was never used
NaN or a blank where a number should be

start: State: the numbers follow what was done, and what was undone

steps.action: Take a payment from a member who owes, then open Today
user_sees: 'Today's collection' is higher by that amount; 'Fees due' is lower; the member left 'Money to collect' if nothing is due any more
must_not: The payment counted twice
The old due amount still shown

steps.action: Cancel (void) that payment, then open Today
user_sees: 'Today's collection' and 'This month' are back down; the member is back in 'Money to collect'
must_not: Cancelled money still counted as collected

steps.action: Archive a member who still owes money, then open Today
user_sees: 'Fees due' still includes that member’s amount
must_not: The gym’s money owed going down because a member was archived

steps.action: Check a member in, then undo the check-in
user_sees: 'Came in today' goes up by one, then back
must_not: A check-in that was undone still counted

start: Privacy and promise: what Today shows, and what leaves the admin app

steps.action: Open Today as the owner and read every card
user_sees: Members’ names, plan end days and amounts due; the gym’s money totals
must_not: Members of another gym or branch that is not the open one

steps.action: On a Monday tap 'Share on WhatsApp'
user_sees: The owner’s own WhatsApp with the week’s totals; no member names or phone numbers in the text
must_not: The gym’s totals sent by MettleUp itself to anyone
Member phone numbers inside the summary text

start: Today, signed in as a front-desk person; a gym with members, payments and check-ins

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: Title 'Today' and the date
Tiles 'Active members', 'Ending today', 'Ending in 1-3 days', 'Ending in 4-7 days', 'Ending in 8-15 days', 'Expired', 'Birthdays today', 'Came in today', 'Enquiries to call'
must_not: The tile 'Today's collection' or 'This month <amount>'
The tile 'Fees due' with the gym’s total

steps.action: Tap 'Came in today'
user_sees: The attendance register
must_not: A money page

steps.action: Go back and read the lists
user_sees: 'Talk to these members', 'Money to collect' (each person’s own '<amount> due') and 'Losing the habit'
must_not: A sum of all dues anywhere on the staff screen

start: Other entry: the card 'Came in today with an ended plan or fees due', as front desk

steps.action: Open Today after a member with an ended plan or fees due checked in
user_sees: Card 'Came in today with an ended plan or fees due' with each person’s 'Plan ended <date>' and '<amount> due'
must_not: A total of money due across the rows

steps.action: Tap 'Message' on a row
user_sees: The ready WhatsApp message sheet for that member
must_not: A message sent before the desk presses send

start: Negative: what a front-desk login is refused on Today

steps.action: Open Today on a Monday
user_sees: No card 'Last week at your gym'
must_not: Last week’s money shown or shareable by a front-desk login

steps.action: Type the address of today’s collections (/money/today)
user_sees: unknown: front desk gets only the dues tab of the money pages (permissions.ts:140); the words shown were not read
must_not: Today’s or this month’s collection total shown to front desk

start: State: the people counts follow the desk’s work

steps.action: Check a member in at the desk, then open Today
user_sees: 'Came in today' is higher by one
must_not: The same member counted twice for one day

steps.action: Renew a member whose plan ended, then open Today
user_sees: 'Expired' is lower by one and 'Active members' higher by one; the member left 'Talk to these members'
must_not: The renewed member still listed as expired

start: Privacy and promise: 'Never sees money totals.'

steps.action: Sign in as front desk and read every card on Today, on a Monday, in a gym with collections and dues
user_sees: People counts and each person’s own due amount only
must_not: 'Today's collection', 'This month <amount>', the 'Fees due' total, or the week summary with money
A money figure inside 'Your numbers' (the money-owed number is the owner’s)
